title: Replace a known resource
summary: REST API Development: Replace a known resource. Write a replacement with 40 pages.
introduction: PUT supplies the desired representation at a known URL. This example replaces the book title and page count.
learningObjectives: Replace a known resource with REST API Development

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Replace a known resource
blocks.code:
PUT /books/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test
Content-Type: application/json

{"title":"Moon Trip","pages":30}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":1,"title":"Moon Trip","pages":30}

blocks.text: The supplied representation includes pages 30. Replacing the resource makes that the stored value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Know whether the API treats omitted fields as removed when using PUT.
